symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: When the byte at +0x708 of an object the system holds is non-zero, for every entity whose ecl::dummy::DummyComponent was added this frame it adds ecl::dummy::StoredClothComponent (helper = AddComponent<ecl::dummy::StoredClothComponent>) whatever the visual, and then, if the entity has a Visual, stores for each mesh carrying a cloth vertex buffer a duplicate of that buffer in the component, keyed by the mesh's resource. So StoredCloth appears on every new photo-mode dummy while the flag is set; cloth only decides what is stored in it.
does.evidence: EoCClient.dll ecl::dummy::StoreClothSystem::StoreDummyCloths @0xB19A70: guard on the +0x708 byte, Added Alive DummyComponent loop, add helper EoCClient.dll+0xB18150 (its type index global's GetTypeName<ecl::dummy::StoredClothComponent>) called before the GetConstVisual test, rf::DataLoader::InvokeDuplicateVertexBuffer per cloth mesh. Review 14 Nov: the add does not depend on cloth meshes.

does.text: When a dummy is removed it releases the stored vertex buffers (RemoveVertexBuffer) of its cloth.
